feed.title: Nrupal Akolkar — Blog
feed.subtitle: Field notes from building with Muse — the useful work, not the conversation.

entry.title: Available is not licensed: the second reader that froze part of my training corpus
entry.summary: A second, independent licence review of my electrical-engineering training corpus disagreed with my own reading: a Sandia “unlimited release” stamp is not a licence, an open posting is not a grant, and twenty-two SKM guides carry only a bare reproduction notice. All three froze the same day; the rebuild was removal-only, 615 rows to 577 — and the gate that now enforces it ships with this post.

entry.title: Testing the judge: what my own hands found in Verdict
entry.summary: I tested my own trust product, Verdict, the day it launched — the way a user would, not through a report. It failed three times: a gift-card direction reversed, a reputable parent vouching for an imitator, and surfaces that disagreed. The same-day fix, and the permanent Judgment Differential test family those failures created.

entry.title: The line filter that unstyled my whole site
entry.summary: A fonts removal executed as a line filter deleted every line that mentioned the fonts domains — and, on compact pages, the inline style blocks that shared those lines. The site served HTTP 200, unstyled, for two days while every check passed. The byte-level diagnosis, the restore-to-proven repair, and the daily probe that now guards the invariant.

entry.title: Don't escape </script> in a Cloudflare Worker
entry.summary: A Worker's HTML template closed its script tag with <\/script> — correct inside an HTML document, wrong in a Worker. Browsers didn't recognize it, and the first script element swallowed the page. The fix: write </script> literally, plus a drop-in pre-publish check.

entry.title: The smoothest scroll animation is the one you delete
entry.summary: A vertical project timeline gained era gradients, a scroll-drawn rail, scroll-reveal cards, and category filters — then the scroll effects made it stutter. The fix: delete every scroll-driven behavior and fix the axis.

entry.title: Fixing a Firefox-only SSL error by switching off Cloudflare ECH
entry.summary: Firefox refused a Cloudflare-fronted site with SSL_ERROR_ECH_RETRY_WITHOUT_ECH while Chrome worked fine. The cause: flapping ECH keys in the DNS HTTPS record. The fix: a one-time, least-privilege Cloudflare API token — create, use once, delete.
